|-------|-----------|

## Phase 0 objectives

1. Document live brand defects honestly  
2. Prototype brand arrival + logo/orb hierarchy  
3. Resolve walkthrough hierarchy and Join authority  
4. Clarify human vs Opal vs execution copy  
5. Research initial audience wedge (hypothesis, not stereotype)  
6. Dual-AI coordination without file collision
